items.title: 11-day education equality campaign starts in Balaghat
items.summary: A committee launches an 11-day yatra from Balaghat to Bhopal demanding equal access to quality education, passing through four districts.
items.content_text:
An 11-day campaign for equal access to quality education began in Balaghat, Madhya Pradesh on November 15. Organized by a committee, the yatra will travel to Bhopal by November 25, passing through Seoni, Chhindwara, Betul, and Narmadapuram districts.
- 11-day education equality campaign launched in Balaghat
- Yatra runs November 15-25 from Balaghat to Bhopal
- Route covers Seoni, Chhindwara, Betul, Narmadapuram
- Committee demands equal access to quality education

items.title: CBSE launches Expression Series on gender equality for Classes III-XII
items.summary: CBSE invites Classes III-XII students to join its 2026-27 Expression Series on women empowerment and gender equality, with entries due Tuesday.
items.content_text:
CBSE has launched its 2026-27 Expression Series for students in Classes III through XII, centered on women empowerment and gender equality with age-appropriate themes. Schools are encouraged to sensitize students on these topics, and entries must be submitted by Tuesday.
- CBSE's 2026-27 Expression Series focuses on women empowerment and gender equality
- Open to students from Classes III to XII with age-wise themes
- Entries due by Tuesday
- Aims to sensitize students on gender equality importance
- Part of CBSE's academic session activities

items.title: NEET 2026: Float and Freeze option leaves medical seats vacant
items.summary: New admission flexibility lets candidates hold seats without joining, contributing to hundreds of unfilled medical seats despite high exam turnout.
items.content_text:
The 2026 NEET counselling introduced a Float and Freeze option allowing candidates to carry forward seat allotments without completing admission formalities. Even if seats remain unchanged in Round 3, candidates can decline to join. This flexibility has led to significant seat underutilisation, with hundreds of medical seats…
- Float and Freeze option introduced in 2026 NEET counselling
- Candidates can hold allotments without completing admission
- Seats can be declined even after Round 3 allotment
- Flexibility linked to hundreds of vacant medical seats
- Millions of students appeared for NEET 2026

items.title: RBI to auction 91-day, 182-day and 364-day Treasury Bills on Nov 18
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India will auction three Treasury Bills worth a total of ₹23,000 crore on November 18, 2026, with settlement on November 19.
items.content_text:
The Reserve Bank of India has announced an auction of three Government of India Treasury Bills on November 18, 2026, totalling ₹23,000 crore. The 91-day and 182-day bills are notified at ₹8,000 crore each, and the 364-day bill at ₹7,000 crore. Settlement is on November 19, 2026.
- The 91-day and 182-day bills are notified at ₹8,000 crore each.
- The 364-day bill is notified at ₹7,000 crore, taking the total to ₹23,000 crore.
- Bids will be submitted electronically on the RBI's E-Kuber system on November 18.
- Retail investors can bid non-competitively, capped at 5 percent of the notified amount.
- Successful bidders must pay on November 19, 2026.

The piece treats valuation as no guarantee of a durable…
- The Hindu says Anthropic's valuation does not by itself secure a lasting edge.
